biotools.summary: 3D-Speckler is a semi-automated software tool for calibrating fluorescence microscopy, enabling precise quantification of fluorescence puncta, including nanoscale 2D/3D particle size, precise locations, and intensity information. It utilizes multispectral fluorescence beads of known sizes alongside the software to calibrate imaging systems.
biotools.name: 3D Fluorescence Speckle Analyzer (3D-Speckler)
